records.deidentified_narrative: on december 24, 2023, at approximately 0845 hours, police responded to the [roadway] for an accident major involving a pedestrian. prior to my arrival, other officers had already made location. i later arrived on scene, and i observed unit 1 (u1) stopped between lanes 1 and 2 on [roadway] after woodstone pass. i observed u1 to have several large dents and scratches on the hood of the vehicle with the hood slightly ajar due to the impact. u1 did not have airbag deployment. i first spoke to ofc. trevino #0025, who was the first officer to make contact with the injured pedestrian (p1). ofc. trevino #0025 stated that p1 was hit by u1 as he was running/jogging. ofc. trevino #0025 reported that p1 was showing signs of possible head trauma but was responsive. he also reported that p1 had scrapes all over his body, as well as arm/shoulder pain. p1 had already been loaded into the safd ambulance. safd medic #40 transported p1 to sammc for further medical treatment. ofc. ramoz #1858 followed safd medic #40 to sammc and gathered further medical updates. per ofc. ramoz #1858, p1 appeared to have a broken shoulder and broken ribs, with a head laceration. i next spoke with the driver of unit 1 (d1) to gather her statement. d1 stated she was traveling northwest on the [roadway] when she saw p1 running in the center of the roadway on the double [roadway] closure up ahead and was about to make an u-turn when p1 ""jerked"" [roadway] of travel causing her vehicle (u1) to collide with p1. while i was speaking with d1, i smelled the odor of intoxicants emitting from her person. i was then waived down by witness 1 (w1), who was working construction up the roadway. w1 stated he heard a ""boom"" and when he turned around he saw p1 on the ground. w1 then saw d1 exit the driver seat of u1, where she went over to check on p1 while on the phone. ofc. carroll #0448 advised me that he had spoken to another witness (w2). w2 stated p1 was running in the middle of the roadway on the double yellow lines. w2 said he was driving in front of u1 when he did a u-turn and looked in his rear view mirror. at that time, he saw p1's shoes fly up in the air. based on my crash investigation, it appeared that p1 was in the roadway on the [roadway] when he was struck by u1. d1 was operating u1 in the northwest lanes of travel at the time of the collision. ofc. jaimes #0302 and ofc. martinez #1698 also conducted a dwi investigation and d1 was placed under arrest for the suspicion of driving while intoxicated. ofc. jaimes #0302 contacted tid (det. pawelek #2131), who later made location for further investigation. csi e. roberson #9431 also made location for processing. after the crash investigation was complete a wrecker was requested for u1. ofc. romo #1840 completed the tsr for u1. u1 was towed to growdon for impound (hold per tid). reference the dwi report for further details. nothing further to report. bwc/coban available.

records.public_safe_text: this is fatality #141 for the city of dallas in 2023. see related [case id]. units 1 and 2 had been involved in a minor accident. see related crash [identifier]-2023. factor 98 - unit 2, a pedestrian, jumped on the driver's side hood of unit 1 as unit 1 accelerated northbound on s r. l. thornton fwy (i-35e). unit 1's momentum set unit 2 in motion. unit 2 fell off of unit 1 [roadway] of traffic. unit 3 was traveling northbound and collided with unit 2. unit 3 left the scene without summoning or rendering aid. unit 2 was transported by ambulance and was pronounced deceased by a medical doctor at 7:50 pm due to injuries sustained in the crash. vehicle crimes unit detectives and supervisor responded to the scene. the scene was forensically scanned by the traffic unit. the investigating officer had body worn camera. the evidence is saved under id# 23-2349417. the dallas county medical examiner's office was notified and is using [case id]. this report is incomplete pending blood toxicology results for unit 2 and the identification of the driver of unit 3.
